source.rationale: The MULTI-WORD-TEAM twin of miss-case-a-prime-plain, and the guard that the team-name display fix (captain 2026-08-24) is applied in the right place. Same arm, same wiring, same single-miss plan; the only difference is that the team is `purchasing_certification` instead of `purchasing` - a real LANE pairing (crm_certificates_list -> purchasing_certification in miss-roster-plan), chosen because `purchasing` and `warehouse` are single words and cannot tell a working prettifier from a missing one. Decision fields derived from the contract BEFORE running the body: (1) the appended sentence reads `Would you like me to escalate to *Sorento* purchasing certification team?` - underscores rendered as SPACES - in BOTH `user_response` and the persisted `variables.response`, byte-identical to each other; (2) the frozen parser prefix `Would you like me to escalate` is untouched, so /would you like me to escalate/i still matches both copies; (3) `variables.routing.suggested_team` still carries the RAW slug `purchasing_certification` - this is the value the next turn's `_sameTeam` comparison and sub-human-intervention route on, and it is the assertion that catches the transform being put at the derivation instead of the interpolation; (4) `routing_roster_plan[0]` carries no `team` key at all - the existing mapping in compile-current-state projects only plan_idx/company_id/company_name/brand_code, so there is no persisted team to prettify by accident (pre-existing behaviour, unchanged by this fix); (5) selection_context stays null and last_result_set is untouched, exactly as on the single-word twin.
